topic: Park/Airport tab release and dashboard issues
summary_markdown:
The new Park/Airport tabs are ready for release, but access needs to be granted to all users under Provantage.

Regarding the conversion dashboard, initial issues with filters were due to a missing deployment of a fix. After deploying the fix, data is no longer loading, suggesting a potential issue introduced by the recent changes. Someone (Саня) will address this after lunch.

It was noted that two tables need further discussion.
decisions: The new Park/Airport tabs are approved for release.
Access to the new Park/Airport tabs must be granted to all Provantage users.
action_items: Someone needs to set up the required roles for the Park/Airport staging environment.
Discuss the two tables mentioned in the conversion dashboard issue.
